reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun Aqua-fresh Rice+B5 (SPF50+ PA++++) 50mL
reviews.text: Overall a solid sunscreen. It goes on nicely and doesn’t leave a cast obviously. I have mild rosacea and reapplying it throughout the day seems to help with its appearance. If you have oily skin, this might act as a standalone moisturizer, but I need a little bit more. It is a bit thicker of a texture than the other BoJ sunscreen.
reviews.zh: 整體嚟講係一款穩陣嘅防曬。搽上去感覺唔錯，明顯唔會泛白。我有輕微玫瑰痤瘡，日間補搽似乎有助改善狀況。如果你係油性肌，呢款可以單獨當保濕用，但我就需要再多一層保濕。質地比起另一支 BoJ 防曬稍為厚身少少。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun Aqua-fresh Rice+B5 (SPF50+ PA++++) 50mL
reviews.text: When I purchased I didn’t realise this was marketed for oily to combination skin whilst my skin is more dry. However I still find it works well on my skin especially in more humid weather. Whilst I prefer the original I usually do have a lot of other skin care underneath so it’s useful to have a light spf sometimes. This is more runny than the original type.
reviews.zh: 買嘅時候冇留意到呢款係針對油性至混合性肌嘅產品，而我嘅皮膚就偏乾。不過我發現佢喺我皮膚上都仲係work，特別係喺較潮濕嘅天氣。雖然我比較鍾意原本嗰款，但因為我通常會疊好多其他護膚品，所以間中有一支輕薄嘅防曬都好實用。呢款比起原本嗰款更加水。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun Aqua-fresh Rice+B5 (SPF50+ PA++++) 50mL
reviews.text: It’s honestly okay… it doesn’t leave a white cast and it’s not oily. i do like its consistency, but it pills after putting it on. I’ve used other sunscreens after my morning routine and those don’t pill. I also think it’s not suitable to my skin because I’ve noticed new breakouts after using it and it’s the only new product I integrated into my routine.
reviews.zh: 老實講okay嘅…唔會泛白，亦唔油。我確實鍾意佢嘅質地，但搽完之後會起擦膠碎。我用過其他防曬喺早上護膚程序之後搽都唔會起擦膠碎。我亦都覺得呢款唔適合我嘅皮膚，因為用咗之後發現爆咗新嘅瘡，而呢款係我新加入護膚程序嘅唯一新產品。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun Aqua-fresh Rice+B5 (SPF50+ PA++++) 50mL
reviews.text: I can't say how this new BOJ sunscreen compares to the old BOJ sunscreen, but it is definitely more watery and less viscous compared to other sunscreens like Round Lab, Numbuzin, and Skin1004. I feel like I have to be extra careful when squeezing the sunscreen out of the tube because of its watery texture. But I think it is due to its texture that it dries on my skin almost instantly with a matte finish. However, I did notice that the sunscreen rubs off easily, almost like pilling, over the course of the day when I would occasionally touch my face. Because of this, I think it's best for the summer weather when one may not need to layer up serums and moisturizers as much.
reviews.zh: 我講唔到呢款新 BOJ 防曬同舊嗰款點比較，但比起 Round Lab、Numbuzin 同 Skin1004 等等其他防曬，呢款明顯更水、更稀。質地偏水，所以我要特別小心從支裝度擠出嚟。但正正因為呢個質地，搽上皮膚之後幾乎即刻就乾，呈現霧面妝效。不過我留意到日間偶爾掂到塊面嘅時候，防曬好容易被擦走，差唔多好似起擦膠碎咁。所以我覺得呢款最適合夏天使用，嗰時通常都唔使疊咁多精華同保濕。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun Aqua-fresh Rice+B5 (SPF50+ PA++++) 50mL
reviews.text: Let me start off by saying I love BOJ. I have gone through multiple bottles of serums and the original sunscreen. I tried to love this one - I used the entire tube and bought the 2 tube set. It pills EVERY time. Without fail. No matter what I use or don’t use for my skincare prior. I still prefer the original BOJ sunscreen and go back to it every day.
reviews.zh: 先講句，我鍾意 BOJ。我用過好多支精華同原本嗰款防曬。我試過嘗試去鍾意呢款——我用晒成支，仲買咗兩支裝。但係每次都起擦膠碎。冇一次例外。唔理之前用咗咩或者冇用咩護膚品都係咁。我依然比較鍾意原本嗰款 BOJ 防曬，日日都會返去用佢。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun Aqua-fresh Rice+B5 (SPF50+ PA++++) 50mL
reviews.text: The woes of having oily skin… this is the closest I’ve come to using a chemical-only sunscreen that doesn’t turn me into an oil slick, but it’s still shinier than I would like. I don’t need the finish to be straight matte, but a satin finish would be nice. This is so close, but it’s dewy after more than an hour or two. It’s an incredibly gentle sunscreen though, and is great for days when my skin barrier is feeling a little compromised, so I’ll finish the tube on days when I need to give my skin a break or when I’m not intending to do any meaningful socializing.
reviews.zh: 油性肌嘅辛酸…呢款係我用過最接近「純化學防曬但唔會變成油光滿面」嘅選擇，但依然比我想像中更光。唔需要妝效係完全霧面，但 satin（絲緞）妝效都好啊。呢款咁接近喇，但過咗一兩個鐘之後就變水光。不過佢係一款非常溫和嘅防曬，啱晒皮膚屏障有少少受損嘅日子，所以當我想畀皮膚休息或者冇打算見人嘅日子，我會用晒成支。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun Aqua-fresh Rice+B5 (SPF50+ PA++++) 50mL
reviews.text: I was excited to try this sunscreen, and it’s definitely lighter and more transparent than the original version. It applies smoothly and absorbs quickly, with a watery, gentle consistency that feels great on the skin. However, I did experience some issues—after a while, my makeup starts to pill, and my skin feels somewhat dirty. While it has its benefits, this one aspect makes it a bit uncomfortable for me personally.
reviews.zh: 我好期待試呢款防曬，比起原本嗰款確實更輕透、更透明。搽上皮膚好滑，吸收得快，水潤溫和嘅質地感覺好舒服。不過我有遇到一啲問題——過咗一陣，妝容開始起擦膠碎，皮膚感覺有啲污糟。雖然佢有佢嘅好處，但呢一點對我個人嚟講有啲唔舒服。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun Aqua-fresh Rice+B5 (SPF50+ PA++++) 50mL
reviews.text:
This is one of the best sunscreen I've ever used and it is so lightweight and feel like moisturizer fr. Trust me when I say feels like moisturizer because I've tried all other sunscreens that has a rumor or review of being lightweight and feels like moisturizer. But none of them was okay for me. Don't get me wrong , the other viral are nice on application but THIS ONE has nothing to do with them. I aslo love the finished which is semi matt after 5 min of application. 

But there is one downside. I had to use very very minimal steps or lightweight watery products before that . On first day of trying , I use Skinfood Carrot toner and Torriden Dive In serum before this and after 3-4 hr , it pills a little. So since I am a man , I don't know if this will pill on make up application or not .. The pilling is not that noticable nor annoying. As long as if you don't rub your face , the pilling is not there but just not sure how it will react with make up.
reviews.zh:
呢款係我用過最好嘅防曬之一，輕到好似保濕霜咁。我講真嘅，係真係好似保濕霜，因為其他被推薦話輕到好似保濕霜嘅防曬我都試過。但冇一款啱我。唔好誤會，其他幾款爆紅嘅搽上感都唔錯，但呢一款根本唔同級。我都好鍾意佢嘅妝效，搽完5分鐘後呈現半霧面。

不過有一個缺點。之前嘅護膚步驟要用得好少，或者係輕薄水狀嘅產品。試嘅第一日，我喺呢款之前用咗 Skinfood Carrot 爽膚水同 Torriden Dive In 精華，過咗3-4個鐘就有少少起擦膠碎。因為我係男人，我唔知化妝嘅時候會唔會起擦膠碎…起擦膠碎唔算明顯亦都唔算煩。只要唔好捽塊面，就唔會起擦膠碎，但就唔知同化妝一齊用會點。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
